originalTitle: Measuring and locating the changes in protein structure using MELO

summaries.zh: MELO 从残基几何特征和残基间相对距离两个维度测量蛋白质结构变化，并定位二级结构变化与蛋白片段位移。
summaries.en: MELO measures protein structural change from residue geometry and relative inter-residue distances, while locating secondary-structure variation and protein-segment shifts.
